_howto: Guided setup for Asset Tagging & Stock Control (Demo / Setup mode). Steps click the menu links (switchTab).
title: Set up Asset Tagging & POS
intro: Work through these in order. You're in demo: nothing is sent to devices or tills, and nothing affects live until you push it.

steps.title: Warehouses
steps.why: Where stock is kept and used.

steps.title: POS setup
steps.why: Rules, items and prices, cashiers and layout for the till.

steps.title: Test run
steps.why:
Prove it works, all in demo:
  1. Receive some stock with a GRV.
  2. Open the POS screen, start the day and sell an item (cash, or on a test employee's account).
  3. Check the stock went down and the sale shows in Sales History.
Stock movements and sales are never pushed to live.
